```{r setup}
if (!require("pacman")) {
    install.packages("pacman")
}
pacman::p_load(
    tidyverse,
    readr,
    janitor,
    sjmisc,
    plm,
    marginaleffects,
    gtsummary,
    car,
    stargazer,
    broom,
    fixest,
    did,
    interflex
)

options(scipen = 999)

panel_aid_admin1 <- read_csv(
    here::here("01_panel_data", "panel_aid_admin1_by_sector.csv")
)
panel_aid_admin2 <- read_csv(
    here::here("01_panel_data", "panel_aid_admin2_by_sector.csv")
)

# Ensure proper ordering before applying lag()
panel_aid_admin1 <- panel_aid_admin1 %>%
    arrange(GID_1, year) %>%
    group_by(GID_1) %>%
    mutate(
        lag_mean_nl = dplyr::lag(mean_nl),
        nl_growth = case_when(
            is.na(lag_mean_nl) ~ NA_real_,
            TRUE ~
                ((log(mean_nl + 0.01) - log(lag_mean_nl + 0.01)) /
                    log(lag_mean_nl + 0.01)) *
                    100
        ),
        lag_hhi_admin1 = dplyr::lag(frag_index_admin1),
        lag2_hhi_admin1 = dplyr::lag(frag_index_admin1, 2),
        lag3_hhi_admin1 = dplyr::lag(frag_index_admin1, 3),
        lag_pop_admin1 = dplyr::lag(ln_pop_admin1),
        lag_sgq_admin1 = dplyr::lag(mean_sgq_admin1),
        lag_donor_count_admin1 = dplyr::lag(donor_count_admin1),
        lag_total_proj_admin1 = dplyr::lag(total_proj_admin1),
        lag_total_aid_admin1 = log(dplyr::lag(total_aid_admin1) + .01)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        nl_growth = case_when(
            is.infinite(nl_growth) ~ NA_real_,
            nl_growth > quantile(nl_growth, probs = .05, na.rm = TRUE) ~ NA_real_,
            nl_growth < quantile(nl_growth, probs = .95, na.rm = TRUE) ~ NA_real_,
            TRUE ~ nl_growth
        )
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

panel_aid_admin2 <- panel_aid_admin2 %>%
    arrange(GID_2, year) %>%
    group_by(GID_2) %>%
    mutate(
        lag_mean_nl = dplyr::lag(mean_nl),
        nl_growth = case_when(
            is.na(lag_mean_nl) ~ NA_real_,
            TRUE ~
                ((log(mean_nl + 0.01) - log(lag_mean_nl + 0.01)) /
                    log(lag_mean_nl + 0.01)) *
                    100
        ),
        lag_hhi_admin2 = dplyr::lag(frag_index_admin2),
        lag2_hhi_admin2 = dplyr::lag(frag_index_admin2, 2),
        lag3_hhi_admin2 = dplyr::lag(frag_index_admin2, 3),
        lag_pop_admin2 = dplyr::lag(ln_pop_admin2),
        lag_sgq_admin2 = dplyr::lag(mean_sgq_admin2),
        lag_donor_count_admin2 = dplyr::lag(donor_count_admin2),
        lag_total_proj_admin2 = dplyr::lag(total_proj_admin2),
        lag_total_aid_admin2 = log(dplyr::lag(total_aid_admin2) + .01)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        nl_growth = case_when(
            is.infinite(nl_growth) ~ NA_real_,
            nl_growth > quantile(nl_growth, probs = .05, na.rm = TRUE) ~ NA_real_,
            nl_growth < quantile(nl_growth, probs = .95, na.rm = TRUE) ~ NA_real_,
            TRUE ~ nl_growth
        )
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

# Split the sample into high and low SGQ
panel_aid_admin1 <- panel_aid_admin1 %>%
    mutate(
        med_sgq_admin1 = if_else(
            lag_sgq_admin1 > quantile(lag_sgq_admin1, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
            1,
            0
        )
    )

panel_aid_admin2 <- panel_aid_admin2 %>%
    mutate(
        med_sgq_admin2 = if_else(
            lag_sgq_admin2 > quantile(lag_sgq_admin2, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
            1,
            0
        )
    )

high_admin1 <- panel_aid_admin1 %>%
    filter(med_sgq_admin1 == 1)

low_admin1 <- panel_aid_admin1 %>%
    filter(med_sgq_admin1 == 0)

high_admin2 <- panel_aid_admin2 %>%
    filter(med_sgq_admin2 == 1)

low_admin2 <- panel_aid_admin2 %>%
    filter(med_sgq_admin2 == 0)


prepare_fe_data <- function(
    data,
    admin_level,
    sector_var) {
    if (admin_level == "GID_1") {
        data <- data %>%
            dplyr::mutate(
                total_aid = total_aid_admin1,
                frag_index = lag_hhi_admin1,
                frag_l1 = lag_hhi_admin1,
                frag_l2 = lag2_hhi_admin1,
                frag_l3 = lag3_hhi_admin1,
                lag_log_pop = lag_pop_admin1,
                lag_governance = lag_sgq_admin1,
                lag_donor_count = lag_donor_count_admin1,
                lag_total_proj = lag_total_proj_admin1,
                lag_total_aid = lag_total_aid_admin1
            ) %>%
            filter(study_group == sector_var)
    } else if (admin_level == "GID_2") {
        data <- data %>%
            dplyr::mutate(
                total_aid = total_aid_admin2,
                frag_index = lag_hhi_admin2,
                frag_l1 = lag_hhi_admin2,
                frag_l2 = lag2_hhi_admin2,
                frag_l3 = lag3_hhi_admin2,
                lag_log_pop = lag_pop_admin2,
                lag_governance = lag_sgq_admin2,
                lag_donor_count = lag_donor_count_admin2,
                lag_total_proj = lag_total_proj_admin2,
                lag_total_aid = lag_total_aid_admin2
            ) %>%
            filter(study_group == sector_var)
    }

    data <- data %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
            high_gov = if_else(
                lag_governance > quantile(lag_governance, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
                1,
                0
            )
        )

    return(data)
}


```



```{r main_res}
perform_stratified_fe_analysis <- function(
    data,
    admin_level,
    outcome_var,
    cluster_var,
    sector_var) {
    data <- prepare_fe_data(data, admin_level, sector_var)

    stage_2_formula <- as.formula(
        paste0(
            outcome_var,
            " ~ lag_total_aid + lag_total_proj + lag_donor_count + lag_log_pop | GID_0^year + ",
            admin_level
        )
    )

    stage_2 <- fixest::feols(
        stage_2_formula,
        cluster = cluster_var,
        data = data
    )

    return(stage_2)
}

run_interaction_fe <- function(
    data,
    admin_level,
    outcome_var,
    cluster_var,
    sector_var,
    gov_spec = c("continuous", "binary")) {
    gov_spec <- match.arg(gov_spec)
    data <- prepare_fe_data(data, admin_level, sector_var)

    rhs_terms <- if (gov_spec == "continuous") {
        "frag_index * lag_governance + lag_total_aid + lag_log_pop"
    } else {
        "frag_index * high_gov + lag_total_aid + lag_log_pop"
    }

    model_formula <- as.formula(
        paste0(
            outcome_var,
            " ~ ",
            rhs_terms,
            " | GID_0^year + ",
            admin_level
        )
    )

    model <- fixest::feols(
        model_formula,
        cluster = cluster_var,
        data = data
    )

    return(model)
}

run_distributed_lag_interaction_fe <- function(
    data,
    admin_level,
    outcome_var,
    cluster_var,
    sector_var,
    gov_spec = c("continuous", "binary")) {
    gov_spec <- match.arg(gov_spec)
    data <- prepare_fe_data(data, admin_level, sector_var)

    rhs_terms <- if (gov_spec == "continuous") {
        paste(
            "frag_l1 + frag_l2 + frag_l3 + lag_governance +",
            "frag_l1:lag_governance + frag_l2:lag_governance +",
            "frag_l3:lag_governance + lag_total_aid + lag_log_pop"
        )
    } else {
        paste(
            "frag_l1 + frag_l2 + frag_l3 + high_gov +",
            "frag_l1:high_gov + frag_l2:high_gov + frag_l3:high_gov +",
            "lag_total_aid + lag_log_pop"
        )
    }

    model_formula <- as.formula(
        paste0(
            outcome_var,
            " ~ ",
            rhs_terms,
            " | GID_0^year + ",
            admin_level
        )
    )

    model <- fixest::feols(
        model_formula,
        cluster = cluster_var,
        data = data
    )

    return(model)
}


# Stratified models
high_1_health <- perform_stratified_fe_analysis(
    high_admin1,
    "GID_1",
    "u5m",
    "GID_0",
    "health"
)
low_1_health <- perform_stratified_fe_analysis(
    low_admin1,
    "GID_1",
    "u5m",
    "GID_0",
    "health"
)

high_2_health <- perform_stratified_fe_analysis(
    high_admin2,
    "GID_2",
    "u5m",
    "GID_0",
    "health"
)
low_2_health <- perform_stratified_fe_analysis(
    low_admin2,
    "GID_2",
    "u5m",
    "GID_0",
    "health"
)

etable(
    high_1_health,
    low_1_health,
    high_2_health,
    low_2_health,
    headers = c(
        "High Admin1 (Health)",
        "Low Admin1 (Health)",
        "High Admin2 (Health)",
        "Low Admin2 (Health)"
    ),
    dict = c(
        lag_donor_count = "Lag Donor Count",
        lag_total_proj = "Lag Total Projects",
        lag_log_pop = "Lag LN(Population)",
        `lag_donor_count:lag_total_proj` = "Lag Donor × Lag Projects",
        lag_total_aid = "Lag LN(Total Aid)"
    ),
    se.below = TRUE,
    signif.code = c("***" = 0.01, "**" = 0.05, "*" = 0.1), # <-- proper format
    fitstat = c("n", "r2")
)

# Interaction models (preferred for testing moderation)
educ_interaction_cont <- run_interaction_fe(
    panel_aid_admin1,
    "GID_1",
    "u5m",
    "GID_0",
    "educ",
    "continuous"
)

health_interaction_cont <- run_interaction_fe(
    panel_aid_admin1,
    "GID_1",
    "u5m",
    "GID_0",
    "health",
    "continuous"
)

educ_interaction_binary <- run_interaction_fe(
    panel_aid_admin1,
    "GID_1",
    "u5m",
    "GID_0",
    "educ",
    "binary"
)

health_interaction_binary <- run_interaction_fe(
    panel_aid_admin1,
    "GID_1",
    "u5m",
    "GID_0",
    "health",
    "binary"
)

etable(
    educ_interaction_cont,
    health_interaction_cont,
    educ_interaction_binary,
    health_interaction_binary,
    headers = c(
        "Educ: Frag × Lag SGQ",
        "Health: Frag × Lag SGQ",
        "Educ: Frag × High SGQ",
        "Health: Frag × High SGQ"
    ),
    dict = c(
        frag_index = "Lag Fragmentation",
        lag_governance = "Lag SGQ",
        high_gov = "High SGQ (Lag, Median Split)",
        `frag_index:lag_governance` = "Lag Fragmentation × Lag SGQ",
        `frag_index:high_gov` = "Lag Fragmentation × High SGQ",
        lag_log_pop = "Lag LN(Population)",
        lag_total_aid = "Lag LN(Total Aid)"
    ),
    se.below = TRUE,
    signif.code = c("***" = 0.01, "**" = 0.05, "*" = 0.1),
    fitstat = c("n", "r2")
)



# Distributed-lag moderation models (t-1 to t-3)
educ_dl_cont <- run_distributed_lag_interaction_fe(
    panel_aid_admin1,
    "GID_1",
    "u5m",
    "GID_0",
    "educ",
    "continuous"
)

health_dl_cont <- run_distributed_lag_interaction_fe(
    panel_aid_admin1,
    "GID_1",
    "u5m",
    "GID_0",
    "health",
    "continuous"
)

educ_dl_binary <- run_distributed_lag_interaction_fe(
    panel_aid_admin1,
    "GID_1",
    "u5m",
    "GID_0",
    "educ",
    "binary"
)

health_dl_binary <- run_distributed_lag_interaction_fe(
    panel_aid_admin1,
    "GID_1",
    "u5m",
    "GID_0",
    "health",
    "binary"

etable(
    educ_dl_cont,
    health_dl_cont,
    educ_dl_binary,
    health_dl_binary,
    headers = c(
        "DL Educ: Frag(1:3) × Lag SGQ",
        "DL Health: Frag(1:3) × Lag SGQ",
        "DL Educ: Frag(1:3) × High SGQ",
        "DL Health: Frag(1:3) × High SGQ"
    ),
    dict = c(
        frag_l1 = "Lag 1 Fragmentation",
        frag_l2 = "Lag 2 Fragmentation",
        frag_l3 = "Lag 3 Fragmentation",
        lag_governance = "Lag SGQ",
        high_gov = "High SGQ (Lag, Median Split)",
        `frag_l1:lag_governance` = "Lag 1 Frag × Lag SGQ",
        `frag_l2:lag_governance` = "Lag 2 Frag × Lag SGQ",
        `frag_l3:lag_governance` = "Lag 3 Frag × Lag SGQ",
        `frag_l1:high_gov` = "Lag 1 Frag × High SGQ",
        `frag_l2:high_gov` = "Lag 2 Frag × High SGQ",
        `frag_l3:high_gov` = "Lag 3 Frag × High SGQ",
        lag_log_pop = "Lag LN(Population)",
        lag_total_aid = "Lag LN(Total Aid)"
    ),
    se.below = TRUE,
    signif.code = c("***" = 0.01, "**" = 0.05, "*" = 0.1),
    fitstat = c("n", "r2")
)
```
